thread:
sylvie: Quick idea — instead of an immediate v3 enforcement, can we run a "nudges" campaign? soft banners in Console + telemetry-driven cutover.
ajay: +1. What's the definition of a "nudge" here? popup? email? banner?
kevin: Banner + API response header mentioning deprecation is safest. Banner can be rate-limited to avoid noise.
maria: We should avoid spamming small customers. telemetry cohorts needed.
sylvie: Proposal: three-phase nudge: 1) non-intrusive Console banner (30 days), 2) response header + one-off usage email (60 days), 3) hard 429 drops. Roll by telemetry signals.
ajay: Sounds reasonable. How do we pick cohorts? by active requests last 7 days? tokens/day?
kevin: Suggest buckets: high-volume customers (manual opt-in for earlier), medium (auto-nudge), low (email only). We'll measure perceived breakage via error/latency spikes.
sylvie: Also want an opt-in toggle on tenant page to preview v3 behavior. Feature flag + preview route.
maria: Telemetry hooks: add field `compat_preview` to request logs + `migration_nudge_shown=true/false`.
kevin: Example banner config (pseudo):
```
{ "banner_id": "v3_nudge_2026_03", "rate": 0.1, "cohort": "medium", "message": "Heads up: API v2 -> v3 coming. Preview in tenant settings." }
```
sylvie: Nice. Deploy plan: feature flag behind `rollout.v3_nudges`, enable in staging, run 24h smoke, then enable at 1% on prod, then scale.
ajay: Need telemetry dashboards: nudge_shown vs `client_error_rate` + `fallback_use`. SRE needs alert if client_error_rate > baseline*1.5
maria: We also need a deprecation header format: `x-redwood-deprecation: v2; replacement="v3"; until=2026-06-01; nudge-id=v3_nudge_2026_03`
kevin: Will add header in gateway response for compatible routes only. We'll implement a middleware that checks tenant opt-outs.
deploy-bot: banner-service@staging deployed: build 1.12.0
sylvie: Okay next steps: (1) Ajay to draft telemetry queries + dashboards, (2) Kevin to implement banner middleware and header, (3) Maria to craft email copy + tenant preview UX, (4) I'll coordinate rollout calendar & comms.
ajay: I'll have dashboard PR ready by EOD Friday.
kevin: I'll open a small RFC for middleware hooks and opt-out semantics.
maria: Draft email in #marketing next. cc @sylvie.
sylvie: Thanks all. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary at 01:00 UTC after staging smoke?
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for 01:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
kevin: small note — let's ensure we don't add header to streaming websocket responses; that'll need special handling.
sylvie: Good catch. add to action items.
maria: Also: include link to migration guide in banner and email: <https://docs.redwood-inference.com/migrations/v2-to-v3>
ajay: If we see high fallback_use, we pause rollout and open incident channel.
sylvie: Cool. I'll update the rollout doc and post a brief to #announcements before phase 1.
kevin: SGTM. :thumbsup:
